pain_point: Worried about Truganina infrastructure - Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there? Roads parking services?
primary_text: "Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there? Roads, parking, services?" The West Gate Tunnel alone is a game-changer for Truganina — cutting CBD travel times and opening a direct freight route that bypasses the West Gate Bridge bottleneck entirely. Add upgraded arterial roads, new signalised intersections, and purpose-built industrial estate infrastructure with proper parking and turning circles for trucks. This isn't the Truganina of ten years ago. Major logistics operators have moved here precisely because the infrastructure now matches the opportunity. These new off-the-plan warehouses sit within a properly serviced industrial estate. Come see the roads yourself.
description: West Gate Tunnel provides a direct CBD freight route bypassing the bridge
